description: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development & Cultural Affairs - Notifying that the maximum fee of 03 copies of photographs applied for Identity card should be Rs. 150/=
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Registration of Persons Act No. 32 of 1968, specifically exercising powers under Section 36(2). It establishes a regulatory framework by setting a maximum fee that photographers can charge for identity card photographs and cancels a previous notification. This content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters - creating and modifying regulations under existing legislation - rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
